FAQ

How do you reach school districts and municipal buyers?

We create SEO and content strategies targeting athletic directors, parks and recreation departments, and facility managers who control equipment budgets for basketball courts.

Can you help with both indoor and outdoor basketball equipment?

Yes. We create separate marketing approaches for indoor gymnasium equipment and outdoor court equipment, each targeting the right buyer personas and procurement processes.

What's the opportunity in basketball court equipment?

Every new court build and renovation includes equipment purchasing. By connecting with our network of court installers, you get your products specified during the construction process.
